module_summary: Wishbone NM-by-NS crossbar: per-master skid buffer and address decoder form requests, a fixed-priority arbiter grants slave channels, index LUTs route requests and returns, and pending counters hold grants.

anchors.name: i_mstb
anchors.why: Per-master Wishbone strobe entering the request skid buffers

anchors.name: i_maddr
anchors.why: Master addresses buffered then decoded into slave requests

anchors.name: i_mdata
anchors.why: Master write data routed to the granted slave port

anchors.name: o_mstall
anchors.why: Per-master stall from skid buffer ready

anchors.name: dcd_stb
anchors.why: Decoder output valid qualifying each master's request vector

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Per-master one-hot decoded slave request (plus no-slave bit) feeding arbitration

anchors.name: m_stb
anchors.why: Decoded master strobe gated by pending-full; counts pending transactions

anchors.name: requested
anchors.why: Priority mask: slave already requested by a lower-numbered master

anchors.name: ARBITRATE_REQUESTS[*].stay_on_channel
anchors.why: Holds current grant while requests or pending transactions remain

anchors.name: ARBITRATE_REQUESTS[*].requested_channel_is_available
anchors.why: Requested slave free and unclaimed by higher priority, enabling new grant

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: Per-master grant vector over slave channels from registered r_grant

anchors.name: mgrant
anchors.why: Master N holds some channel; gates acks, errors and return data

anchors.name: SLAVE_GRANT[*].drop_sgrant
anchors.why: Releases a slave grant when owning master drops cycle or moves on

anchors.name: sgrant
anchors.why: Per-slave busy grant; gates slave cyc/stb and new grants

anchors.name: ARBITRATE_REQUESTS[*].MINDEX_MULTIPLE_SLAVES.r_regrant
anchors.why: Candidate slave channels for master regrant computing next mindex

anchors.name: mindex
anchors.why: Slave index granted to each master; selects return data, ack, stall

anchors.name: sindex
anchors.why: Master index owning each slave; selects forwarded address, data, strobe

anchors.name: s_stall
anchors.why: Slave stall while strobing; holds slave outputs and master stall

anchors.name: o_scyc
anchors.why: Per-slave bus cycle from r_scyc while granted master holds cyc

anchors.name: o_sstb
anchors.why: Per-slave strobe from r_sstb carrying routed requests

anchors.name: o_saddr
anchors.why: Registered slave address selected from master via sindex

anchors.name: o_sdata
anchors.why: Registered slave write data routed from owning master

anchors.name: i_sdata
anchors.why: Slave read data returned to the granted master

anchors.name: s_ack
anchors.why: Slave ack qualified by cyc, routed to master via mindex

anchors.name: s_err
anchors.why: Slave bus error; aborts slave cycle and returns master error

anchors.name: o_mdata
anchors.why: Per-master read data muxed from slave data by mindex

anchors.name: o_mack
anchors.why: Per-master acknowledge routed from granted slave

anchors.name: o_merr
anchors.why: Per-master bus error from slave error, no-slave decode or timeout

anchors.name: COUNT_PENDING_TRANSACTIONS[*].lclpending
anchors.why: Outstanding transactions per master; keeps grant until all acked

anchors.name: mempty
anchors.why: No pending transactions; allows master to switch channel

anchors.name: mfull
anchors.why: Pending counter full; blocks master strobe and forces stall

anchors.name: timed_out
anchors.why: Optional deadlock timeout forcing bus error; disabled when OPT_TIMEOUT=0

groups.name: Master request decode
groups.description: Per-master skid buffer and address decoder producing one-hot slave requests

groups.name: Priority arbiter
groups.description: Fixed-priority grant of slave channels to masters with hold while pending

groups.name: Routing index tables
groups.description: Registered master-to-slave and slave-to-master indices steering forward and return muxes

groups.name: Slave port drivers
groups.description: Registered cyc/stb/we/addr/data/sel per slave selected from owning master

groups.name: Return path
groups.description: Muxes slave data, ack and error back to each master by mindex

groups.name: Pending transaction counters
groups.description: Per-master outstanding count with empty/full flags gating grant changes and strobes
